ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.description: Identifier is an opaque, stable identifier within a declared namespace.

namespace.description: namespace prevents an identifier string from crossing a domain boundary.

value.description: value is opaque to consumers and must be non-empty after boundary validation.

ouroboros.contracts.v1.Identifier.jsonsc.title: Identifier

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ReconcileConnecto.description: ReconcileConnectorSuccess reports cursor advancement and delta object counts.

admittedObjectCount.description: admitted_object_count is the number of objects newly admitted.

connectionId.description: connection_id echoes the opaque connection identity.

deletedObjectCount.description:
deleted_object_count is the number of objects confirmed deleted after a
 complete reconcile; partial pages never contribute deletions.

nextCursor.description: next_cursor advances only after a complete page commits.

pageComplete.description: page_complete is true only when the provider page set fully committed.

priorCursor.description: prior_cursor is the cursor accepted before this reconcile.

state.description: state is READY or DEGRADED after the reconcile attempt.
state.title: Connector Lifecycle State

ouroboros.contracts.v1.ReconcileConnecto.title: Reconcile Connector Success
